model: The service I want to describe is a music streaming app that I pay for every month. It costs around sixty thousand dong, which is about the price of two cups of coffee, so it's not a big expense. I decided to sign up for it about three years ago. Before that, I used the free version, but there were adverts every few songs, which meant that I got annoyed and kept skipping. Then the company offered a three-month free trial, and after using it, I simply couldn't go back. Now it's become an essential part of my routine. I listen to it on the go, on my way to work, at the gym, and when I'm cooking in the evening. Due to the offline feature, I can download playlists at home and listen without using mobile data, which saves me money on my phone plan. I've also discovered lots of new artists through its recommendations, and that's led to me going to a couple of live concerts. I'd say it's worth every penny, because I use it for at least two hours a day, so I definitely get my money's worth. Another thing I like is that I can cancel at any time. As a result, I don't feel trapped, which is how I feel about my gym membership, to be honest. Overall, it's the one subscription I'd keep even if I had to cut back on spending.
